acquisition_method.evidence: inferred: Raw data were processed with MaxQuant (version 1.6.14.0; ref.) and searched using the Andromeda search engine against a comprehensive Swiss-Prot database release for human.
A standard data-independent acquisition was performed for retention time–based scheduling using Biognosys’ high-precision normalized iRT concept.

cleavage_agent.evidence: After tryptic digestion, the peptides were desalted and labeled using tandem mass tag pro reagents (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Samples were digested overnight with sequencing grade trypsin (Promega) at a protein/endoproteinase ratio of 50:1.

fractionation_method.evidence: Pooled samples were fractioned offline using basic reversed-phase chromatography and recombined using a noncontinuous pooling scheme, as described previously.
